name: Esquema Nacional de Seguridad
source: Real Decreto 311/2022, Anexo II, texto consolidado del BOE (BOE-A-2022-7191)
notes: op.acc.5 and op.acc.6 are written for the authentication of people; a token or a cloud key in code is a machine's credential, placed under them by interpretation.
A cryptographic key in the files adds op.exp.10.
A site's findings fall under the measures of communications (mp.com) and of web services and e-mail (mp.s.1, mp.s.2); open services under configuration, maintenance and the secure perimeter.
